readinessStatement: No live connection can be declared ready without platform-admin-supplied nonsecret readiness evidence. This example does not claim live validation.
examplePurpose: Safe offline fixture configuration. Copy this file to connections.json only when creating a local non-production override.

valueGuide.connectionAlias: A short harness-owned name used in MCP calls, such as cloud-dev. It is not a URL.
valueGuide.appId: The stable Qlik app ID allowed by policy. It is not the app display name.
valueGuide.sheetId: The stable Qlik sheet ID allowed for writes in that app. It is not the sheet title.
valueGuide.displayAliases: Human-readable labels only; they never route a connection or authorize a target.
valueGuide.visualizationSchemaProfile: Required compiler compatibility profile. Cloud uses qlik-cloud-current. Windows uses the profile matching its installed release.
valueGuide.visualizationSchemaVersion: Required only for qlik-windows-november-2025-or-later. Record a semantic version validated against that exact Windows host; do not copy the Cloud version by assumption.
valueGuide.runtimeAddresses: Tenant/server web addresses belong in .env or the deployment platform, never in this policy file.
valueGuide.secrets: OAuth secrets, JWTs, certificates, passphrases, and tokens never belong in this file.
